<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.66em;">
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For now, let us forget about tokens and consider a single-variable objective:</span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex13" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<span><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex13.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\min_{x\geq 0}f(x)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><munder><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">min</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow></munder><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" lspace="0em" mathcolor="#000000">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\min_{x\geq 0}f(x).</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">An optimal <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> means that <em id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">no feasible small move</em> from <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> can reduce the function value.
A move is <em id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">feasible</em> if it respects the constraint <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math>. Thus:
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">i)</span> if <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math> (an interior point), we can move a small amount both to the right and to the left, i.e., to <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}+\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}+\delta</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}-\delta</annotation></semantics></math>, for sufficiently small <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>;
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">ii)</span> if <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}=0</annotation></semantics></math> (a boundary point), we can only move to the right (to <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0+\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0+\delta</annotation></semantics></math>), since <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0-\delta</annotation></semantics></math> would violate <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math>. To make this precise, we use a first-order Taylor approximation. For small <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>,</span></span>
<span id="S2.EGx8" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<span id="S2.Ex14"><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="S2.Ex14.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle f(x^{\star}+\delta)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle f(x^{\star}+\delta)</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="S2.Ex14.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\approx f(x^{\star})+\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≈</mo><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\approx f(x^{\star})+\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star}),</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex15"><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="S2.Ex15.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle f(x^{\star}-\delta)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle f(x^{\star}-\delta)</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="S2.Ex15.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\approx f(x^{\star})-\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≈</mo><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" lspace="0em" mathcolor="#000000">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\approx f(x^{\star})-\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star}).</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Since <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> is optimal, any feasible move must not decrease <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f</annotation></semantics></math>, i.e.,</span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex16" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<span><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex16.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f(x^{\star}+\delta)-f(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{for all sufficiently small feasible }\delta&gt;0," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mtext style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">for all sufficiently small feasible </mtext><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x^{\star}+\delta)-f(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{for all sufficiently small feasible }\delta&gt;0,</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">and, when <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math> (so that <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}-\delta</annotation></semantics></math> is also feasible),</span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex17" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<span><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex17.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f(x^{\star}-\delta)-f(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{for all sufficiently small }\delta&gt;0." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mtext style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">for all sufficiently small </mtext><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" lspace="0em" mathcolor="#000000">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x^{\star}-\delta)-f(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{for all sufficiently small }\delta&gt;0.</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Combining these inequalities with the Taylor expansions gives the two cases below:</span></span>
<span id="S2.I4" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="S2.I4.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="S2.I4.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Case I (Interior optimum <math id="S2.I4.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>):</span><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> both </span><math id="S2.I4.i1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}+\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}+\delta</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> and </span><math id="S2.I4.i1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}-\delta</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> are feasible. Hence</span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex18" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<span><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex18.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{and}\quad-\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\forall\delta&gt;0," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mtext style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">and</mtext><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">−</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><mspace style="width:1.167em;" width="1.167em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" rspace="0.167em">∀</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\text{and}\quad-\delta f^{\prime}(x^{\star})\geq 0\quad\forall\delta&gt;0,</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">which implies </span><math id="S2.I4.i1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f^{\prime}(x^{\star})=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(x^{\star})=0</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I4.i1.p1.2.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="S2.I4.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="S2.I4.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Case II (Boundary optimum <math id="S2.I4.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}=0</annotation></semantics></math>):</span><span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> only </span><math id="S2.I4.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0+\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">+</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0+\delta</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is feasible. Hence</span></span>
<span id="S2.Ex19" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<span><span class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex19.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\delta f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0\quad\forall\delta&gt;0," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><mspace style="width:1.167em;" width="1.167em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" rspace="0.167em">∀</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">δ</mi></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\delta f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0\quad\forall\delta&gt;0,</annotation></semantics></math></span>
<span class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></span></span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">which implies </span><math id="S2.I4.i2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math><span id="S2.I4.i2.p1.2.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">In other words, these conditions reflect whether <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> lies in the interior or on the boundary of the feasible set.
If <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}&gt;0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">&gt;</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}&gt;0</annotation></semantics></math>, we can perturb <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> both to the right and to the left while remaining feasible, and optimality therefore forces the slope to vanish, i.e., <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f^{\prime}(x^{\star})=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(x^{\star})=0</annotation></semantics></math>.
If <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="x^{\star}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">⋆</mo></msup><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^{\star}=0</annotation></semantics></math>, we can only move “into” the feasible region (to the right), so optimality only requires that rightward perturbations do not decrease <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f(\cdot)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" lspace="0em" mathcolor="#000000" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(\cdot)</annotation></semantics></math>, equivalently <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p2.pic1.m23" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">f</mi><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">≥</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(0)\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math> (a one-sided slope condition).</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Having understood what conditions we would need when having a non-negativity feasibility set, we can now go back to our tokens and apply the same reasoning coordinate-wise to each component <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q(v)\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q(v)\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math>. In our problem, the role of <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f^{\prime}(x^{\star})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(x^{\star})</annotation></semantics></math> is played by the partial derivative of the Lagrangian with respect to the coordinate <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q(v)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q(v)</annotation></semantics></math>. Recall the Lagrangian:</p>
<table id="S2.Ex20" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex20.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}(q,\eta)\;=\;\lambda\Omega(q)-\langle q,s_{t}\rangle+\eta\Big(\sum_{u\in\mathcal{V}}q(u)-1\Big)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>η</mi><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>λ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>η</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">(</mo><mrow><mrow><munder><mo lspace="0em" movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow></munder><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo maxsize="1.600em" minsize="1.600em">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}(q,\eta)\;=\;\lambda\Omega(q)-\langle q,s_{t}\rangle+\eta\Big(\sum_{u\in\mathcal{V}}q(u)-1\Big),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.2" class="ltx_p">where the scalar <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>η</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta</annotation></semantics></math> enforces the normalisation constraint <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{u}q(u)=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>u</mi></msub><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{u}q(u)=1</annotation></semantics></math>. Taking the partial derivative with respect to <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q(v)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q(v)</annotation></semantics></math> yields:</p>
<table id="S2.Ex21" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex21.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q,\eta)\;=\;\lambda\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\Omega(q)(v)-s_{t}(v)+\eta." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>η</mi><mo rspace="0.280em" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.558em">=</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>λ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>η</mi></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q,\eta)\;=\;\lambda\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\Omega(q)(v)-s_{t}(v)+\eta.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.3" class="ltx_p">By the same one-dimensional argument as above, optimality under the constraint <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q(v)\geq 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q(v)\geq 0</annotation></semantics></math> implies a <em id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.3.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">two-case</em> condition:</p>
<table id="S2.Ex22" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S2.Ex22.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\begin{cases}q^{\star}(v)&gt;0\;\;\Rightarrow\;\;\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q^{\star},\eta)=0,\\[4.0pt]
q^{\star}(v)=0\;\;\Rightarrow\;\;\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q^{\star},\eta)\geq 0.\end{cases}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>{</mo><mtable columnspacing="5pt" stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0.838em" rspace="0.838em" stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>q</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>η</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow></mtd><mtd></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd class="ltx_align_left" columnalign="left"><mrow><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>q</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0.838em" rspace="0.838em" stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mstyle><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>q</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>η</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow></mtd><mtd></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\begin{cases}q^{\star}(v)&gt;0\;\;\Rightarrow\;\;\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q^{\star},\eta)=0,\\[4.0pt]
q^{\star}(v)=0\;\;\Rightarrow\;\;\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(q^{\star},\eta)\geq 0.\end{cases}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.4" class="ltx_p">Substituting the expression for <math id="S2.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p3.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(\cdot,\cdot)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mo>∂</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo rspace="0em">,</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial}{\partial q(v)}\mathcal{L}(\cdot,\cdot)</annotation></semantics></math> and rearranging gives us two conditions for the optimality of the solution, which we state below.</p>
</div>

<section id="S3" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_font_bold ltx_title_section" style="font-size:144%;">3  LLM Decoding Strategies are Different Regularisers</h2>

<div id="S3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At this point, the reader may reasonably wonder what all of the preceding mathematics was for. We now reap what we have sown (Galatians 6:7). In this section, we show that many widely used decoding strategies arise as simple special cases of our general formulation. Those will correspond to different choices of regularisation <math id="S3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Omega(q)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Omega(q)</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="S3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>λ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{C}_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒞</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{C}_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<section id="S3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_font_bold ltx_title_subsection" style="font-size:120%;--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">3.1  Greedy Decoding: The Boring but Necessary Case</h3>

<div id="S3.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S3.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We begin with the simplest possible case, which serves mainly to reassure us that nothing has gone terribly wrong. To recover greedy decoding, we assume there is no regulariser by setting <math id="S3.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\lambda=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>λ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\lambda=0</annotation></semantics></math>. We also ignore <math id="S3.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{C}_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒞</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{C}_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> for the time being. As such, our “Master” objective from Equation (<a href="#S2.E1" title="In 2.2 Decoding as Distributional Optimisation ‣ 2 Decoding, Sampling and Optimisation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>) quietly collapses into a far more modest one:</p>
<table id="S3.Ex23" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex23.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{t}^{\star}=\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\langle q,s_{t}\rangle\equiv\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\sum_{v}q(v)s_{t}(v)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>arg</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></munder></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟨</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≡</mo><mrow><mi>arg</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mrow><mi>max</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mmultiscripts><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>v</mi></munder><mprescripts></mprescripts><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{t}^{\star}=\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\langle q,s_{t}\rangle\equiv\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\sum_{v}q(v)s_{t}(v).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div id="S3.SS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S3.SS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">We now “cash in” the take-home KKT-style conditions from Equation (<a href="#S2.E5" title="In Getting the Inequality Back. ‣ 2.2 Decoding as Distributional Optimisation ‣ 2 Decoding, Sampling and Optimisation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a>). In this greedy case, we have for some scalar <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>η</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="S3.Ex24" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex24.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\text{\scriptsize\color[rgb]{0.0508,0.2773,0.6328}ACTIVE}\ \ q_{t}^{\star}(v)&gt;0\ \Rightarrow\ s_{t}(v)=\eta,\qquad\text{\scriptsize\color[rgb]{0.5,0.5,0.5}INACTIVE}\ \ q_{t}^{\star}(v)=0\ \Rightarrow\ s_{t}(v)\leq\eta." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mtext style="--ltx-fg-color:#0D47A1;" class="ltx_font_smallcaps" mathcolor="#0D47A1" mathsize="0.700em">ACTIVE</mtext><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0.778em" rspace="0.778em" stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>η</mi></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mtext style="--ltx-fg-color:#808080;" class="ltx_font_smallcaps" mathcolor="#808080" mathsize="0.700em">INACTIVE</mtext><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0.778em" rspace="0.778em" stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mi>η</mi></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{\scriptsize\color[rgb]{0.0508,0.2773,0.6328}ACTIVE}\ \ q_{t}^{\star}(v)&gt;0\ \Rightarrow\ s_{t}(v)=\eta,\qquad\text{\scriptsize\color[rgb]{0.5,0.5,0.5}INACTIVE}\ \ q_{t}^{\star}(v)=0\ \Rightarrow\ s_{t}(v)\leq\eta.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S3.SS1.p2.2" class="ltx_p">These two lines already characterise the solution: every token that receives a nonzero probability
must have <em id="S3.SS1.p2.2.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">exactly the same</em> score, and every token with zero probability must have a score no larger. Let <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M:=\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M:=\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u)</annotation></semantics></math> and define the argmax set</p>
<table id="S3.Ex25" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex25.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{V}^{\star}:=\arg\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u)=\{v\in\mathcal{V}:s_{t}(v)=M\}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>:=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>arg</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow></munder></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{V}^{\star}:=\arg\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u)=\{v\in\mathcal{V}:s_{t}(v)=M\}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S3.SS1.p2.3" class="ltx_p">The inactive condition forces <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta\geq s_{t}(v)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>η</mi><mo>≥</mo><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta\geq s_{t}(v)</annotation></semantics></math> for all <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>v</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v</annotation></semantics></math>, hence <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta\geq M" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>η</mi><mo>≥</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta\geq M</annotation></semantics></math>.
But the active condition says there exists at least one active token (since <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sum_{v}q_{t}^{\star}(v)=1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mi>v</mi></msub><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sum_{v}q_{t}^{\star}(v)=1</annotation></semantics></math>),
and any active token must satisfy <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{t}(v)=\eta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>η</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{t}(v)=\eta</annotation></semantics></math>, hence <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>η</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta</annotation></semantics></math> must equal the maximum score: <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta=M." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>η</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta=M.</annotation></semantics></math> Therefore, the only tokens that can be active are those in <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{V}^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{V}^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math>, i.e.,</p>
<table id="S3.Ex26" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex26.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{t}^{\star}(v)&gt;0\ \Rightarrow\ v\in\mathcal{V}^{\star},\qquad\text{equivalently}\qquad\operatorname{supp}(q_{t}^{\star})\subseteq\mathcal{V}^{\star}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo lspace="0.778em" rspace="0.778em" stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mtext>equivalently</mtext><mspace style="width:2.167em;" width="2.167em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><mi>supp</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>⊆</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{t}^{\star}(v)&gt;0\ \Rightarrow\ v\in\mathcal{V}^{\star},\qquad\text{equivalently}\qquad\operatorname{supp}(q_{t}^{\star})\subseteq\mathcal{V}^{\star}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S3.SS1.p2.4" class="ltx_p">In words: <em id="S3.SS1.p2.4.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">an optimal solution places all probability mass on the highest-scoring token(s).</em>
If the maximiser is unique, <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{V}^{\star}=\{v^{\star}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{V}^{\star}=\{v^{\star}\}</annotation></semantics></math>, then the unique optimum is the degenerate distribution</p>
<table id="S3.Ex27" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex27.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{t}^{\star}(v)=\delta_{v^{\star}}(v),\qquad\text{where}\qquad v^{\star}\in\arg\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u)." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>δ</mi><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mtext>where</mtext><mspace style="width:2em;" width="2em"></mspace><mrow><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>arg</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow></munder></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{t}^{\star}(v)=\delta_{v^{\star}}(v),\qquad\text{where}\qquad v^{\star}\in\arg\max_{u\in\mathcal{V}}s_{t}(u).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S3.SS1.p2.5" class="ltx_p">If there are ties (i.e., <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\mathcal{V}^{\star}|&gt;1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>&gt;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\mathcal{V}^{\star}|&gt;1</annotation></semantics></math>), then <em id="S3.SS1.p2.5.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">any</em> distribution supported on <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{V}^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{V}^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math> is optimal. In other words,
greedy decoding corresponds to selecting a vertex of this optimal face, i.e., picking one <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="v^{\star}\in\mathcal{V}^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v^{\star}\in\mathcal{V}^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math>
and using <math id="S3.SS1.p2.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{t}^{\star}=\delta_{v^{\star}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>δ</mi><msup><mi>v</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msup></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{t}^{\star}=\delta_{v^{\star}}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_font_bold ltx_title_subsection" style="font-size:120%;--ltx-fg-color:#808080;">3.2  From Negative Entropy to Softmax: A Predictable Ending</h3>

<div id="S3.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S3.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let us now consider the case where, in a move that will surprise no one, <math id="S3.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Omega(q)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Omega(q)</annotation></semantics></math> is chosen to be the negative entropy of <math id="S3.SS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>q</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q</annotation></semantics></math>, such that: <math id="S3.SS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Omega(q)=\sum_{v\in\mathcal{V}}q(v)\log q(v)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>q</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="0.111em">=</mo><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Omega(q)=\sum_{v\in\mathcal{V}}q(v)\log q(v).</annotation></semantics></math> This will make our optimisation objective from Equation (<a href="#S2.E1" title="In 2.2 Decoding as Distributional Optimisation ‣ 2 Decoding, Sampling and Optimisation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>) look like the following:</p>
<table id="S3.Ex28" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="S3.Ex28.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{t}^{\star}=\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\left[\sum_{v}q(v)s_{t}(v)-\lambda\sum_{v}q(v)\log q(v)\right]." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>arg</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><munder><mi>max</mi><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></munder></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mrow><munder><mo lspace="0em" movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>v</mi></munder><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>λ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>v</mi></munder><mrow><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{t}^{\star}=\arg\max_{q\in\Delta(\mathcal{V})}\left[\sum_{v}q(v)s_{t}(v)-\lambda\sum_{v}q(v)\log q(v)\right].</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="S3.SS2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Returning to the conditions in Equation (<a href="#S2.E5" title="In Getting the Inequality Back. ‣ 2.2 Decoding as Distributional Optimisation ‣ 2 Decoding, Sampling and Optimisation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a>), the suspense is, of course, which case applies: active or inactive? This hinges on a single question: does <math id="S3.SS2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q^{\star}_{t}(\cdot)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mi>q</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>⋆</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">⋅</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q^{\star}_{t}(\cdot)</annotation></semantics></math> live comfortably in the interior of the simplex, or does it press up against the boundary?</p>
</div>
<div id="S3.SS2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="S3.SS2.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="219.25" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 670 219.25"
